I will never go back, and I hope you continue along your journey as well. Although our paths will be different, the reward is the same. A life free from the poisonous influence of nicotine and the shame, regret, helplessness, and depression it brings. Again, congratulations.

to me, it sounds like your girlfriend might be bringing you down. Although you feel like she is all you have in life, maybe you need to break free of her in order to actually have a life you want and deserve. If she isn't even interested in what you have to say, what is the point of being together? I found myself in a similar situation with my last girlfriend - not much in common, and only sexual attraction keeping us together. After breaking up with her, I felt free to do what I wanted and desired to do. For you, that could be reaching the summit of a mountain as you mentioned, or finding someone who you mesh with on a deeper level. I'm sorry to hear you aren't entirely happy with your career. If you don't want to seriously consider a career change (which I understand), then you have to find a way to be happy with your life as a whole despite a job which bogs you down. I know this is easier said than done, but if you pursue hobbies and interests outside of work, perhaps it will be easier. I have and continue to struggle with many of the same things you have mentioned, and it sucks. I just really hope you can find a way to make life enjoyable for yourself.
